list.name: Harry's Pizza
list.description:
Harry's Bishop's Corner Pizza, located at 732 North Main Street in West Hartford, is a casual local pizzeria specializing in traditional and seasonal pizzas, grinders, and a selection of beer and wine. They offer dine-in, takeout, delivery, and catering services.

Their hours of operation are:
-- Monday: 3:00 PM – 8:00 PM
-- Tuesday through Thursday & Sunday: 11:30 AM – 8:00 PM
-- Friday and Saturday: 11:30 AM – 9:00 PM

list.name: The Brownstone
list.description:
The Brownstone is a neighborhood pub and restaurant located at 7 South Main Street in West Hartford, Connecticut. It specializes in freshly prepared pub grub, artisan pizzas, sandwiches, and daily drink and food specials. In addition to dine-in service, they offer daily happy hour, online ordering, catering, and hosting for private events.

-- The Brownstone: (860) 206-1856

list.name: First Peak Construction
list.description:
First Peak Construction is a commercial general contractor and construction management firm with New England roots and offices in East Longmeadow, Massachusetts, and Middletown, Connecticut. They specialize in handling projects across various sectors—including corporate, healthcare, industrial, retail, education, and places of worship—offering services from pre-construction to field execution, self-perform trade packages, and real estate strategy.

-- First Peak Construction: (860) 431-0644

list.name: Mozz & Co
list.description:
Mozz & Co is an neighborhood deli located at 22 Raymond Road in West Hartford, Connecticut. They blend traditional deli favorites with a modern Italian flair, specializing in hand-stretched fresh mozzarella made daily, imported Italian meats and cheeses, scratch-baked breads, artisanal sandwiches, and house-made desserts like tiramisu, alongside catering services.

-- Contact Number: (860) 969-6347

list.name: Penn Lincoln Strategies
list.description: Penn Lincoln Strategies is a full-service government relations and public affairs consulting firm operating in the Greater Hartford, Connecticut area and Washington, D.C. They specialize in legislative and administrative lobbying, strategic communications, and strategic advocacy to help companies, associations, and business leaders navigate the political and regulatory process.

list.name: Pediatric and Adolescent Speech Therapy Associates
list.description:
Pediatric and Adolescent Speech Therapy Associates (helpkidstalk.com) is a family-centered clinic located at 51 North Main Street in West Hartford, Connecticut. With over 25 years of experience, their team of licensed speech-language pathologists provides comprehensive evaluations and personalized therapy services for infants, children, and adolescents.

-- Contact Number: (860) 523-9790

list.name: Lucky Star
list.description:
Lucky Stars Asian Cuisine is an Asian restaurant located at 474 Prospect Avenue in Hartford, Connecticut. They offer an extensive menu of Chinese and Asian dishes, traditional favorites, chef's specialties, American options, and a selection of vegan-friendly dishes and mock meats. They provide pickup and delivery services.

-- Contact Number: (860) 937-5928

list.name: Main Street ROI
list.description:
Main Street ROI is a digital marketing agency that helps small businesses, marketing managers, and other agencies grow online. They offer a full suite of services, including Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, social media management, consulting, white-label agency partnerships, and digital marketing training.

Contact Numbers:
-- Toll-Free: 1-888-405-0307
-- Phone: (646) 470-3753

list.name: Mindful Path Counseling & Wellness
list.description: Mindful Path Counseling & Wellness is a specialized psychotherapy practice based in the West Hartford area, serving clients across Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Pennsylvania. Founded by therapist Allison Burke, the practice focuses on therapy for women navigating anxiety, high-functioning perfectionism, maternal mental health, postpartum transitions, and midlife or perimenopausal shifts.

list.name: Midstate Radiology Associates
list.description:
Midstate Radiology Associates is an outpatient diagnostic imaging provider with locations across Connecticut (affiliated with Hartford HealthCare systems like The Hospital of Central CT and MidState Medical Center). Operating since 1955, they offer a wide range of radiology services, including 3T MRIs, CT scans, 3D mammograms, digital X-rays, ultrasounds, nuclear medicine, and interventional radiology.

Contact / Scheduling Number:
-- Main Appointment Line: (203) 694-8405
